title: The Sorcerer's Manuscript
description: A blue-skinned sorcerer in a green robe and red pointed hat sits on a rocky ledge, reading an illuminated book. In the foreground, a hand with green nails and a metal bracer reaches toward scattered, paint-splattered papers surrounded by white flowers and glowing lanterns, while a swirling circular portal above reveals floating faces and a green feline-like creature with a white mask.
prompt: A blue-skinned wizard wearing a tall red pointed hat and flowing green robe sits cross-legged on a rocky outcrop reading an ancient glowing book. A human hand with long green fingernails and a wide metal bracer reaches from the bottom of the frame toward scattered handwritten papers covered in red and yellow paint splatters. The foreground is filled with white flowers and glowing lanterns on vines. Above the wizard, a large circular swirling portal in the sky contains multiple floating human faces and a green feline humanoid creature with a white mask and ornate jewelry, all set against a bright blue sky with clouds.
